title: Northgate Tire Center Warranty Accounting Worksheet — Treadwear Credit
content:
# Worksheet: the treadwear credit

**Definition.** On a Northgate Tire Center package, the treadwear credit is the price paid per tire, multiplied by the treadwear remaining mileage share and rounded to the cent. The claim it settles is the most recent treadwear claim entry recorded on the package.

## Quantities

1. **Price paid per tire.** The tire unit price recorded on the package, less every price adjustment and every mail-in rebate credited per unit on the tires' purchase line for the tire item number; it is the tire unit price itself where none was credited. The price adjustment and mail-in rebate lines are those recorded on the purchase on which the tires were bought, for the same item number.
2. **Miles driven.** The odometer on the claim entry less the installation odometer recorded on the package.
3. **Treadwear remaining mileage share.** The tire's treadwear warranty miles less the miles driven, never below zero, divided by the treadwear warranty miles. For a tire model whose treadwear warranty miles are zero, the share is zero.
4. **Prorated treadwear amount.** The price paid per tire multiplied by the treadwear remaining mileage share.
5. **Treadwear credit.** The prorated treadwear amount, carried at full precision and rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Item | Case A | Case B |
|---|---|---|
| Tire unit price | $180.00 | $150.00 |
| Per-unit price adjustment on the purchase line | $15.00 | none |
| Per-unit mail-in rebate on the purchase line | $10.00 | none |
| Price paid per tire | $155.00 | $150.00 |
| Treadwear warranty miles | 60000 | 40000 |
| Installation odometer | 12000 | 8000 |
| Odometer on the claim entry | 57000 | 50000 |
| Miles driven | 45000 | 42000 |
| Remaining mileage share | 15000 divided by 60000, that is 0.25 | 40000 less 42000 is below zero, so 0 |
| Treadwear credit | $38.75 | $0.00 |
